paragraphs.source_en: The Mii Kannon Hall in the western provinces stood atop a hill, some five chō northwest of Chikamatsu Temple in Shiga District, Ōmi. It was already the depths of winter, and the trees had shed all their leaves. The precious sunlight threaded through the bare branches like a tailor's needle and thread, casting its gentle warmth upon the ground. From there, Chikamatsu Temple could be seen to the right, while to the left the lofty halls of Onjōji Temple could be surveyed in the distance.
